name: @ekaragodin/clone
description: Clone repositories into an organized source directory and open your editor.
author: Evgenii Karagodin (https://ekaragodin.com)

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e 'import { rmSync } from "node:fs"; rmSync("dist", { recursive: true, force: true })' && tsc
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test.js dist/cli.test.js
